text.preparation.waterline.name: Race-Gate Chalk
text.preparation.waterline.description: Lowers up to three nearby shallow-water layers and records the worked waterline.
text.preparation.weapon-repair.name: Tallow Gear Wrap
text.preparation.weapon-repair.description: Restores 30 condition to the physical readied weapon; the greasy wrap is spent.
text.preparation.storm-light.name: Storm Wick
text.preparation.storm-light.description: Restores two lamp measures and clears two nearby smoke fields under a sheltered hood.
text.preparation.storm-light.condition: spent lamp oil or nearby smoke
text.preparation.item-recovery.name: Wreck Cork Sling
text.preparation.item-recovery.description: Floats one nearby loose physical item directly into the pack when space permits.
text.preparation.item-recovery.condition: a ground item within four paces and pack room
text.preparation.fire-blanket.name: Damp Ember Blanket
text.preparation.fire-blanket.description: Smothers up to four nearby fires and burning hostile conditions without creating new water.
text.preparation.fire-blanket.condition: nearby fire or a burning hostile
text.preparation.firebrand.name: Resin Firebrand
text.preparation.firebrand.description: Ignites one dry adjacent fuel without lamp oil; the flare makes the courier's position known.
text.preparation.firebrand.condition: dry adjacent reeds, timber, cloth, resin, oil, or charcoal
text.preparation.high-sounding.name: Stair Sounding Cord
text.preparation.high-sounding.description: From elevation, marks the nearest unread cache while its sounding alerts nearby listeners.
text.preparation.high-sounding.condition: an elevated regional position and unread cache
text.preparation.footing.name: Scree Binding
text.preparation.footing.description: Clears poor footing or cut feet and preserves one guarded reposition.
text.preparation.bank-plug.name: Peat Bank Plug
text.preparation.bank-plug.description: Lowers nearby water and seats one support in the same worked soil or timber footing.
text.preparation.ration.name: Fen Ration Cake
text.preparation.ration.description: Clears one fatigue, chill, or smoke-inhalation pressure and restores one health.
text.preparation.ration.condition: fatigue, chill, smoke inhalation, or lost health
text.preparation.bridge-dogs.name: Bridge Dog Pair
text.preparation.bridge-dogs.description: Seats up to two nearby damaged supports; the hammering reports to listeners.
text.preparation.bridge-dogs.condition: nearby damaged timber or stone support
text.preparation.aim-break.name: Echo Muffler
text.preparation.aim-break.description: Breaks up to three visible prepared hostile lanes and dampens accumulated noise.
text.preparation.aim-break.condition: a nearby prepared hostile lane or accumulated noise
text.preparation.drain-tile.name: Fired Drainage Tile
text.preparation.drain-tile.description: Turns one adjacent patch of mud into a dry, ash-marked drainage footing.
text.preparation.kiln-sand.name: Kiln Sand Pouch
text.preparation.kiln-sand.description: Quenches one adjacent fire, strips three fuel, and leaves concealing ash smoke.
text.preparation.ice-peg.name: Marked Ice Peg
text.preparation.ice-peg.description: In winter, freezes one adjacent fresh shallow into marked footing and rings once.
text.preparation.ice-peg.condition: winter and adjacent unfired fresh water
text.preparation.thaw.name: Thaw Kettle Sachet
text.preparation.thaw.description: Spends one lamp measure or nearby fire to thaw three ice cells and clear chill.
text.preparation.status.not_carried: the physical preparation is not in this courier's pack

text.preparation.result.storm-light: restores lamp oil {before}→{oil} and clears {cleared} smoke fields
text.preparation.result.fire-blanket: smothers {changed} nearby fires or burning bodies
text.preparation.result.firebrand: ignites dry {material} at {coordinate} without lamp oil and exposes the courier
text.preparation.result.high-sounding: marks {cache}; its report adds three noise
text.preparation.result.footing: clears {statuses} and preserves one guarded step

text.preparation.result.bridge-dogs: seats {supports} supports and adds four hammering noise
text.preparation.result.aim-break: breaks {targets} prepared lanes and dampens noise {before}→{noise}
text.preparation.result.drain-tile: turns mud at {coordinate} into a dry ash-marked drain footing
text.preparation.result.kiln-sand: quenches {coordinate}, strips fuel {before}→{fuel}, and raises ash smoke
text.preparation.result.ice-peg: freezes one fresh shallow at {coordinate} and rings once
text.preparation.result.thaw: thaws {cells} ice cells, clears chill, and {heat}
text.preparation.overlay.guidance: The field slate records the needed conditions; a refused use spends neither watch nor carried thing.
